outcome.technical: R16: _affected_tests.run_listing reads a stop from a ContextVar (_LISTING_STOP) that prefetch_listings sets inside each worker call. When a stop is set, the wait polls communicate every _STOP_POLL_SECONDS. Once the stop is seen, the worker that reads the pipe tears the group down with _proc_group.stop_and_drain (no second reader races the drain) and returns exit 130; a listing whose stop came before Popen never starts. prefetch_listings now submits futures, waits in 0.1 s steps (a signal the kernel hands a worker thread wakes no blocked main thread), and on BaseException sets the stop, cancels the pending futures, shuts the pool down and re-raises. run_listing keeps its four positional arguments because the recorder stubs in tests/test_run_test_gate.py and tests/test_audit_task.py (outside this task's files) replace it with that shape - that is why it is a context variable and not an argument. R17: the drive-phase usage text's exit-0 clause for restore also names a dropped copy. R18: restore_tree's restored and dropped lines name the tree through shown_tree(tree). R19: af38 and the new af43 wrote the pid file through an unquoted path, so under a spaced TMPDIR the redirect went to another file and the case read no grandchild. The teardown itself was right (exit -15, ended at 1.0 s). Both now quote with shlex.quote. Build guide: the _affected_tests facts paragraph states the interrupt teardown.
